column1: # RADIO GATE WARNING for this lane: Crappie Attitude, Crappie Day and Crappie
# Hour all read as "crappy" and all three say a word over VHF that sounds like
# something else entirely. They are legitimate names and genuinely funny on a
# transom; they are also exactly what the radio gate exists to flag.
